A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

Survivin splice variant expression in breast cancer tissues and exosomes in the patient serum are correlated and that the Survivin-Ex3 splice variant is the predominant Survivin splice form expressed in breast cancer.

the Survivin pathway is a potential therapeutic target in breast cancer, with the Survivin-ΔEx3 variant being the preferred target.
the Survivin family of proteins are differentially expressed and packaged in breast cancer patients’ serum exosomes, suggesting their utility as a diagnostic marker in breast cancer patients.
